purpose: Evaluate whether each canonical stock has a sufficiently coherent, fresh, research-aligned live execution scenario for downstream decision evaluation without generating or authorizing a trade.

inputs.stage6: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.stage7: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output
inputs.stage8: Stage 8 PSY29 Portfolio Edge Ranking output
inputs.stage9: Stage 9 PSY29 Candidate Quality Confidence output
inputs.stage10: Stage 10 PSY29 Candidate Integrity Provenance output
inputs.stage11: Stage 11 PSY29 Live Execution Analysis output

12A_upstream_eligibility.purpose: Verify that all required Stage 5-11 prerequisites are valid before Stage 12 analysis.
requirements: Stage 6 coverage and data state are valid.
Stage 7 coverage and activation state are valid.
Stage 8 coverage and ranking integrity are valid.
Stage 9 coverage and candidate-quality integrity are valid.
Stage 11 state is valid for scenario analysis.

12B_live_structural_coherence.purpose: Evaluate whether the live structural observations are internally coherent.

12C_research_live_scenario_match.purpose: Determine whether the current live environment sufficiently resembles the research-conditioned behavioural scenario.

12D_execution_environment_quality.purpose: Evaluate live execution-environment quality without calculating or recommending execution parameters.

12E_scenario_classification.purpose: Classify the observable current market scenario without selecting a trade direction.

12F_final_readiness_gate.purpose: Determine whether the current live scenario is sufficiently coherent for downstream decision evaluation.

execution_scenario_ready: Live structural coherence is HIGH or MODERATE.
Execution environment quality is HIGH or MODERATE.
execution_scenario_conditional: All required upstream data is valid.
No stale or invalid dependency exists.
One or more non-fatal conditions remain partial or moderate.
execution_scenario_blocked: Required upstream data is valid but scenario coherence is insufficient.
Scenario classification cannot support a coherent downstream evaluation.
data_stale: Stage 12 must preserve the stale state.
data_invalid: Required live data is malformed, contradictory, missing, or unverifiable.

provenance_contract.traceability_direction: Stage 12 -> Stage 11 -> Stage 10 -> Stage 9 -> Stage 8 -> Stage 7 -> Stage 6 -> Stage 5

fail_closed_rules: Missing canonical symbols invalidate the run.
Duplicate canonical symbols invalidate the run.
Missing upstream data cannot become valid.
Stale live data cannot become valid.
Invalid live data cannot become valid.
Missing provenance blocks valid Stage 12 classification.
Historical research evidence must remain behavioural evidence only.
No trade decision may be emitted.
immutability_rules: Stage 12 must not modify Stage 2-11 logic.
Stage 12 must not modify the canonical 29 universe.
Stage 12 must not modify historical research evidence.
Changes to this contract require an explicit Stage 12 version change.
Stage 12 readiness must never be interpreted as trade authorization.
